# API Operation Requirements Quality Checklist: Operação POST de registro de imagem de produto

**Purpose**: Validate the *quality* of the contract requirements for T-002-2 — the first mutating operation ever declared in this contract — before `/speckit-plan` builds on them
**Created**: 2026-07-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Depth**: Standard · **Audience**: Reviewer (PR) · **Companion to**: [requirements.md](./requirements.md) (spec-level quality gate)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests whether the requirements are *written* well — not whether the YAML works.

## Evaluation Result (2026-07-25)

Ran against `spec.md` at generation time. **34 of 40 passed on first read; 6 failed and drove spec edits.** All 40 pass after the edits below.

| Item | Finding | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| CHK002 | **Most substantive.** FR-013 mandated rewriting the Path Item `description`, but the spec never stated the **replacement text** — the target snippet showed only the `post` block. A required rewrite with no specified result is unimplementable and unverifiable. | Restructured *Elementos alvo* into two explicit parts, part (1) being the full replacement `description`. FR-013 rewritten to name its three mandatory content elements and to require the now-false sentence to disappear. |
| CHK008 | Consequence of CHK002: FR-014's "only removed lines belong to the description" could not be applied without knowing the intended replacement. | FR-014 now anchors both sides — prior text (§Contexto técnico) and replacement (§Elementos alvo 1) are fixed in the spec, so the diff is judgeable. |
| CHK033 | Duplicate-image-URL outcome was neither declared nor deferred — a reader could not tell whether `409` was rejected or forgotten. | Added an Edge Case deferring it to T-002-3 **with the reason**: "what counts as a duplicate" is undecidable until the request body shape exists. Added matching Out of Scope entry. |
| CHK034 | Maximum images per product neither specified nor excluded. | Added an Edge Case placing the limit with the `images[]` attribute (T-003 chain), plus an Out of Scope entry. |
| CHK003 | Placement of the `post` block appeared only as a comment in the YAML snippet, never as a requirement. | Folded into FR-001: `post` after `parameters`, as the Path Item's last element. |
| CHK005 | No `operationId` uniqueness requirement, though OpenAPI demands it. | Added to FR-002, naming the two existing ids so the check is concrete. |

No item was waived. No unresolved ambiguity blocks `/speckit-plan`.

**Pattern worth noting**: four of the six failures (CHK002, CHK003, CHK005, CHK008) were *under-specification of the deliverable itself*, not of its boundaries — the opposite of the T-002-1 run, where the failures clustered on scope boundaries. The non-additive nature of this change (a rewrite rather than a pure insertion) is what created the new failure mode.
